description: This file defines a custom Akka mailbox class 'ThingPersistenceActorMailbox' for handling 'ThingModifyCommand' messages with capacity-based rejection logic, including an inner class implementing the message queue behavior.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
classes.description: Custom Akka mailbox class that manages message queuing with capacity-based rejection for 'ThingModifyCommand' messages.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox.ThingPersistenceActorMessageQueue
classes.description: Inner class implementing the message queue with capacity checks and rejection logic, extending LinkedBlockingDeque.

methods.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
methods.description: Constructor initializing mailbox capacity from config, called by Akka.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new message queue instance.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues messages; applies capacity check for 'ThingModifyCommand'.

methods.name: enqueueFirst
methods.description: Enqueues messages at the front; applies capacity check for 'ThingModifyCommand'.

methods.name: queueSizeBasedAction
methods.description: Performs capacity check; rejects 'ThingModifyCommand' if capacity exceeded, otherwise runs provided Runnable.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: hasMessages
methods.description: Checks if queue is not empty.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Clears remaining messages, forwarding them to deadLetters.
